contexts.text: The Spirit of God () means the Lord's mercy, of which brooding is predicated, like that of a hen on her eggs; here, on those things which the Lord stores up in man, and are called remains.

Waving = vivification, for truths are not alive with a man until they are in good. The priest who waved the sheaf, that is, who vivified the goods of truth, represented the Lord, for all life is from Him.

Their instruction in truths, protection from falsities, and the opening of the interiors of their minds so that they come into the light of Heaven, and thus into the understanding of truth and good, which is intelligence, is described by an eagle, its nest on high, its brooding over its young, and its bearing them on its wings ().
The flutterings of its breadth () = reasonings from falsities against truths.
